summary: Reproduced that ResponsesRequest silently discarded prompt_cache_key, then added the OpenAI field and forwarded it as GenerateReqInput.cache_salt when the native cache_salt is absent. An explicit native cache_salt retains precedence. A single-gfx950 tiny-Llama serving run observed cached-token counts 0/43/0/43 for prompt-cache keys A/A/B/B.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before issue reproduction: prompt_cache_key was absent from ResponsesRequest.model_dump() while cache_salt remained null. Raw output: reports/j-743166142ea1/raw/failing-before-schema.txt

61 focused protocol/serving tests and 2 subtests passed, including schema preservation, adapter forwarding, native cache_salt precedence, and absent/empty boundaries. Raw output: reports/j-743166142ea1/raw/focused-tests-after.txt
Recreated the pinned deterministic two-layer Llama fixture with weight SHA256 6632fab7c351a0bd85518d80a89ec673f68139587f5ad3fa8d5ab38fad87e75f outside the worktree.

A source-checkout server executed on one gfx950 GPU. Four /v1/responses requests with identical 44-token input and keys A/A/B/B all returned HTTP 200 with cached_tokens 0/43/0/43. Ordinary generate/completions/batch/stream probes also returned HTTP 200. The owned process group was stopped and reaped.

gpu_execution.evidence: Torch reported one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) using ROCm 7.2. The final server log records real GPU prefill/decode and the A/A/B/B cached-token pattern. See reports/j-743166142ea1/raw/gpu-environment.txt and raw/gpu-http-final/.

remaining_limitations: The deterministic fixture validates HTTP transport, Responses adaptation, engine execution, and radix-cache namespace behavior only; its random tiny Llama weights do not validate semantic accuracy.
The reported NVIDIA RTX 5090 and Qwen3.8-27B hybrid GDN configuration and 36,022-token latency measurements were not available and were not reproduced.
No multi-node or distributed workload was tested.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.

The pinned fixture needed a private minimal chat template for /v1/responses because its tokenizer has no bundled chat_template. Two diagnostic attempts are retained: one documents that prerequisite and one documents an overlong-prompt max_new_tokens rejection.
